reason: I'm not letting a bot I've never heard of sign into my Google account and read my staff chat. Most of my spending is cash to mechanics and fuel slips anyway, and a notebook works fine for that.
objection: A tiny new bot gets into my Google and my work group. Who sees that, and will it still exist next year once I've built my books on it?
would_change_my_mind: Another rental owner I know using it for a year, plus a way to run it without handing over my Google login, for example just forwarding receipts to it privately.
